<!-- pr-reviewer: d487984539af0cc7df647ba996dc842e40658c18 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Thank you for this change. The docs now tell the two meanings of "mill-turn" apart.

### What looks good

- The PR does all that #2581 asks for. The box with the two meanings is in `operations-turning.md`, in the Mill-turn section of `machines.md`, and in the `load_machine` row of the `camcraft-mcp` skill.
- The glossary has a new entry "Turning on a mill". The Mill-turn entry names `millturn.mch`.
- The facts agree with the code:
  - `assets/machines/millturn.mch` has the model `MULTITASKING 5-AXIS` and the kind `mill-turn`.
  - The built-in preset name `"Mill-turn"` is in `crates/app/src/posting_files.rs:80`.
- The literal values (`.mch` kind values, the UI kind filter list, a quoted refusal text) do not change. That is correct.
- `docs/decisions/2581-mill-turn-glossary.md` records the choice and the dropped options.
- The body has `Process change: yes`, because the PR changes `.claude/skills/`. The PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. The body has `Changelog: none` and ends with `Fixes #2581`. The commit subject is a conventional `docs:` subject.

### Results merged with main

Run locally, on a trial merge with `upstream/main` (`3c761b5bb`). The merge has no conflicts.

- Safety tier: no. The PR changes no code, no posted G-code, no gouge or collision check, no stock simulation and no geometry.
- Rust build and gate: not run. The PR changes no Rust source and no `Cargo.toml`.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests`: 65 tests. Merged PR: 14 failures, 6 errors. `upstream/main` without the PR: the same 14 failures and the same 6 errors. The PR adds no failure. The errors come from no `node` on the review machine. The failures are in pages that this PR does not change.
- `zola build`: not run on the review machine. The author reports a clean build with Zola 0.23.6. The new link `@/guide/check-and-post/machines.md#mill-turn` points to the existing heading `## Mill-turn`.
- UI screenshots: not necessary. The PR does not change `crates/ui`.

### Extra suites run

- TEST DATA: none. The PR changes no file under `testdata/` and no fixture or golden directory.
- IMPORTERS: none. The PR changes no import code.

### Requested before merge

None.

### Notes (not blocking)

1. `site/content/guide/reference/glossary.md:142` (**Work spindle**) still has a bare "lathe or mill-turn". The same page defines the term, so the meaning is clear. A later edit can add "(live tooling)" for consistency.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The maintainer gave the order to merge this PR. Merge class: SAME (no commit after the reviewed head). The merge relies on the review by mkinney with the marker for head `d487984539af0cc7df647ba996dc842e40658c18`. Thank you for the work, `sn3ro`.

<!-- pr-reviewer: d487984539af0cc7df647ba996dc842e40658c18 -->
**Verdict: clean review, read-only (no build needed: docs-only).**

What was checked:
- The change is text only: the guide pages, `README.md`, one glossary
  pair of entries, the `load_machine` row of the `camcraft-mcp` skill,
  and one decision file. No Rust code, no machine file, no test.
- The facts in the text are correct on current `main`: `millturn.mch`
  states model `MULTITASKING 5-AXIS` and kind `mill-turn`; the other
  setup (turning on a mill) is still not supported (#2580).
- The branch base is older than the solidcore STEP switch. The merged
  tree will contain exactly the current `main` code plus this text: the
  code half is already gated. Two files changed on both sides
  (`.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`,
  `site/content/guide/getting-started/first-run.md`); the hunks do not
  overlap and GitHub reports MERGEABLE. Per the solidcore rule, a gate
  on the merged tree is still owed before the merge.
- Process files: the PR edits `.claude/skills/` and the body states
  `Process change: yes`. The body is complete (what changed, readings,
  pinning tests: none, not exercised, `Changelog: none`, `Fixes #2581`).
  `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is untouched. The merging session bumps the
  version and announces it on #681.
- The two reported site-test failures (the missing
  `site/static/icons/act-report.png`) are pre-existing on `main`, not
  caused by this change.

State: merge-ready stands - a collaborator review at this head now
exists (this comment). The author's reading notes are accurate.
